laws.rule: Penalties for importing and possessing drugs are severe and include the death penalty. Authorities have executed foreigners for drug-related offences in recent years.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: Get professional advice if you're involved in local legal proceedings. In particular, seek legal advice on matters of family law, such as: divorce child custody child support Local authorities consider domestic violence to be a private family matter. Iranian law does not prohibit domestic violence. Authorities have stopped Australians and Australian-Iranian dual nationals, including mothers with children, from leaving Iran. Husbands can legally place border alerts ('stop orders') on their spouse and children where there are pending custodial disputes. Overturning stop orders can be a time consuming and complicated process. The Australian Government cannot prevent or overturn a stop order on
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: Do not enter into surrogacy arrangements. The security situation is extremely volatile in Iran. Seek independent legal advice before considering any surrogacy arrangement. If you travel for surrogacy and the situation deteriorates, you may be unable to leave. Seek independent legal advice before considering any surrogacy arrangement. If, despite our advice, you take part in commercial surrogacy arrangements, you'll need to travel to an Australian Embassy or Consulate outside Iran, at your own expense, to obtain a travel document for your child. You may need to apply for and obtain citizenship by descent through Australia's Department of Home Affairs. Your child must stay in Iran with appropr
laws.heading: Surrogacy

laws.rule: Iran has strict Islamic codes of dress and behaviour. It's illegal to behave in a way considered to offend Islam. If you convert or try to convert someone from Islam to another religion, you could face harsh punishment. In public women are required by law to wear: loose-fitting clothing to cover arms and legs a long coat a headscarf If you fail to follow these dress requirements, you may be detained, fined or denied access to government and other services. Men should not wear shorts or sleeveless T-shirts in public.
laws.heading: Dress and behaviour

laws.rule: It's illegal to photograph sensitive sites or events and you're at high risk of arrest or detention. Sensitive sites may not always be clearly marked. Do not photograph: military and nuclear sites government buildings and installations critical civil infrastructure public demonstrations
laws.heading: Photography

laws.rule: Under Iranian law, dual nationals must enter and exit on their Iranian passport. Iranian immigration officials routinely confiscate the foreign and Iranian passports of dual nationals. Australians have been detained and had passports confiscated.
laws.heading: Electronic equipment

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Smartraveller advises Do not travel. A visa is needed before travel, applied for through the Iranian Embassy in Australia. Evidence of travel to Israel leads to refusal of entry and deportation.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Visa through the Iranian Embassy in Australia before travel (no other route on the pages read).
visa-preparation.before_departure: Apply through the Iranian Embassy, check that nothing in the passport, luggage or devices links to travel in Israel, and keep to the visa dates: an overstay brings a fine and needs an exit visa.

steps.step: Contact the Iranian Embassy in Australia to apply for a visa before travel.
Check for anything that shows travel to Israel (stamps, Egyptian or Jordanian border stamps from Israel crossings, tickets, tags, SIM cards): it leads to refusal and deportation.
Don't overstay: an overstay brings a fine the Australian Government can't pay, and an exit visa is needed.

moving_calendars: Nowruz: the Persian new year, 1 Farvardin 1406, falls at the March 2027 equinox (20 or 21 March); Sizdah Bedar, the outdoor thirteenth day, follows about 2 April. Long school and work break; domestic travel peaks.

Ramadan 1448 expected to begin about 8 February 2027; Eid al-Fitr about 9 or 10 March 2027; Eid al-Adha about 16 or 17 May 2027; Islamic New Year 1449 about 5 to 7 June 2027. Expected dates from astronomical calculation; local moon sighting can move each by a day. Iran declares its own lunar dates, which can differ from the Gulf by a day.
Tasua and Ashura (9 and 10 Muharram 1449): expected mid-June 2027, about ten days after the Islamic New Year; mourning observances.
protocol_notes: During Ramadan and Muharram mourning, public eating, music and dress expectations change; follow local lead.

facts.text: Foreign ownership of IP, official licensing formalities, and whether the system is first-to-file, should be confirmed on the official IP office pages (and, where listed, on WIPO Lex). This pass records the official office rather than a full statute summary.

research-and-enterprise.summary: Official universities, special economic zones, grants and industry strengths in Iran.

facts.label: Official investment or enterprise agency
facts.text: Organization for Investment, Economic and Technical Assistance of Iran (OIETAI) publishes official investment, university-linked, special-economic-zone or industry-priority information for this place.

facts.label: Official opportunities
facts.text: Named special economic zones, official grants and published industry strengths, where they exist, are listed by the official investment or education authorities. This pattern records official opportunity information for any Australian passport holder; it is not the personal Works and purpose fit pattern.
